description: Lien Read-time impact annotator: surfaces dependents/coverage/complexity as a system reminder when the model reads an indexed file. A habituation guard (default on) annotates each file at most once per session and only above a blast-radius risk floor (LIEN_ANNOTATE_GUARD/LIEN_ANNOTATE_MIN_RISK). Plus write-time hooks: a delta warning (a function whose complexity newly crossed a threshold), a blast-radius warning (an exported symbol's signature changed or was removed), and a test-association reminder (which tests to run) that also records the edit for the did-you-run-the-tests verification nudge. A Bash hook records observed test runs. At session Stop, a single session risk-ledger recap re-raises UNRESOLVED risk from the session — edited files whose associated tests were never observed running, functions still crossing a complexity threshold (live lien delta vs HEAD), and exported-API changes never followed by a get_dependents check — as one advisory (LIEN_RECAP). Each nudge records shown/acted-on events for the `lien stats` funnels (LIEN_NUDGE_EVENTS).
